subject: Renewal: 2026 EU primary + APAC standby orchestration and capacity
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Marsh <lydia@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal: 2026 EU primary + APAC standby orchestration and capacity

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the great conversation last week. As we head into the 2026 renewal conversations, I wanted to put a concise proposal on the table that addresses Horizon Health’s priorities: EU data residency for primary traffic, an APAC warm-standby for regional traffic spikes, and a cross-region failover orchestration plan that preserves residency guarantees.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Term: 12 months (renewal start 2026-01-01).
- EU primary: All production inference routed to our EU-only tenancy and logging retained per EU retention policy.
- APAC standby: Replica capacity in APAC configured as standby (warm), only used for failover or scheduled bursts; KV/cache not replicated beyond EU unless explicitly enabled.
- Failover orchestration: Automated regional routing with traffic cutover rules (active-passive) and explicit approval gates; failover telemetry surfaced in the Console.
- Capacity: Baseline steady-state throughput for Horizon @ 500 req/s with 1.5x burst entitlement for APAC-triggered runs.
- Pricing: renewal pricing includes a standby capacity reservation fee (monthly) + per-token usage; see attached mutual action plan for line items.

Questions for you so we can finalize the contract amendment:
1) Do you want APAC standby to ever serve live EU-origin requests for latency-sensitive endpoints if we add a contractual data-replication waiver?
2) Any changes to retention window requirements for EU audit logs?
3) Timeline preferences for a phased APAC rollout (pilot -> warm-standby -> soft-failover testing)?

I've attached the updated EU residency configuration doc for your security team to review (EU-Residency-Config-v2.pdf) and a draft mutual action plan for contracting steps (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx).

If it helps, I can line up a 30-minute technical run-through with Soojin (our regional ops lead) and Ben (your renewal pricing owner). Proposed next step: confirm whether you want APAC standby to be permitted to serve with a waiver; if yes, we include a controlled replication clause.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Renewals | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

---
Attachment: EU-Residency-Config-v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (xls)

From: Lydia Marsh <lydia@horizonhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal: 2026 EU primary + APAC standby orchestration and capacity

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and attachments. A few clarifications from my side before we commit internally: 

- We absolutely need EU primary for all PHI-processing endpoints. That cannot be served from APAC under normal conditions.
- For scheduled bursts (e.g., weekends with APAC-origin traffic), we are open to a standby approach but only if: (a) replication of any user-identifying KV entries is opt-in and auditable, and (b) we have a guaranteed soft-cutover test window before any live traffic flows.
- Retention: we want audit logs retained 7 years for EU production; can you confirm Redwood supports that in EU tenancy or if we need an archiving add-on?

Also please confirm the standby monthly reservation fee you mentioned in line items and whether there's a conversion credit if we convert standby capacity to primary mid-term.

Appreciate the offer for a technical run-through — please include Soojin and Ben. I can loop in our Head of Security (cc: ops@horizonhealth.com) after that call.

Regards,
Lydia
CISO, Horizon Health

Subject: Re: Renewal: 2026 EU primary + APAC standby orchestration and capacity

Vanessa —

Quick technical notes so we can answer Lydia’s questions on the call: 
- EU tenancy supports 7-year audit retention via an archiving add-on we can enable; I'll confirm the exact storage cost and include as a contract line.
- APAC standby behavior: by default we do not replicate KV cache across regions. We can offer an opt-in replication (customer-controlled flag) that will replicate only non-PHI keys. We need Horizon to provide a key-classification map so automation can enforce that.
- Conversion credit: propose a 50% pro-rated credit of the remaining reservation fee if standby capacity is promoted to primary mid-term; legal to confirm.
- Operationally, Soojin and I can run a soft-failover exercise (4-hour window) during the pilot. We’ll need Horizon Ops to provide a test traffic window.

Attaching EU-Residency-Config-v2.pdf — includes the specific tenancy, log sinks, and retention buckets. Attached MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx contains a timeline draft and deliverables.

Next steps I suggest:
- Tech kickoff with Horizon Ops, Soojin, Ben — propose Thu 2025-06-19 09:00 BST.
- Security review after tech call, then amendment draft (redline) within 5 business days.

Ben Carter
Renewals Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Renewal: 2026 EU primary + APAC standby orchestration and capacity

Hi Lydia —

Thanks — confirming items and locking next steps below.

Agreed bullets for the amendment:
- EU primary tenancy for all PHI endpoints; APAC standby only serves after a documented failover trigger or explicit waiver.
- KV replication: opt-in and role-gated; Horizon provides key-classification map prior to pilot.
- Retention: 7-year audit log retention enabled via archiving add-on (line item included).
- Standby reservation: monthly fee listed in the MAP; 50% conversion credit applies if promoted to primary mid-term (pending legal sign-off).
- Soft-failover test: 4-hour test window during pilot; Redwood will provide playbook and test-run telemetry.

Planned timeline: 
- Thu 2025-06-19: Tech kickoff (Soojin/Ben + Horizon Ops) — intent: pilot config walkthrough and test window scheduling.
- Week of 2025-06-23: Security review and finalization of EU-Residency-Config.
- Week of 2025-07-01: Contract amendment redline shared; DocuSign ready after sign-off.

Action items (owners):
- Horizon: provide key-classification map and confirm test traffic window (Lydia / Horizon Ops).
- Redwood (Ben): confirm archiving cost and share exact line item.
- Redwood (Priyom): draft amendment language for KV replication waiver and conversion credit.
- Redwood (Vanessa): circulate final MAP and open DocuSign when redline clears legal.

Doc link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-redwood-hd3892
DocuSign (prep): https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/HD-3892-amend

Thanks all —
